'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Operation 1027]]
***The [[Three Brotherhood Alliance]] claimed that it captured the towns of [[Kutkai]] and [[Theinni]] on midnight after seizing junta military posts in the towns, including the headquarters of the [[Myanmar Army#Military Operations Commands (MOC)|16th Military Operations Command]] in Theinni. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/myanmars-brotherhood-alliance-seizes-two-more-towns-in-shan-state.html (Irrawaddy)]
**[[Tatmadaw]] airstrikes kill at least 17 people, including nine children, and injure 20 others in Kanan village, [[Sagaing]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/air-attack-northwestern-myanmar-kills-1-including-children-106171007 (ABC News)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***The [[Sudan People's Liberation Movement–North|SPLM-N (al-Hilu)]] seized control of [[Dalang, South Kordofan|Dalang]] following reports of an agreement between the group and the SAF to fight the RSF. [https://sudantribune.com/article281102/ (Sudan Tribune)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**At least ten people are killed during three separated confrontations between [[Palestinians]] and [[Israel]]'s [[Israel Border Police|border police]] and [[Israel Defense Forces|army]] in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://apnews.com/article/jenin-israel-west-bank-palestinians-c0265c5fc60cd8874d1dface7bf287a6 (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[81st Golden Globe Awards]]
**''[[Oppenheimer (film)|Oppenheimer]]'', directed by [[Christopher Nolan]], wins five awards at the [[81st Golden Globe Awards]], while ''[[Poor Things (film)|Poor Things]]'' wins the awards for [[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy|Best Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy]] and [[Golden Globe Award for Best Actress – Motion Picture Comedy or Musical|Best Actress – Motion Picture Musical or Comedy]] [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2024/01/08/oppenheimer-leading-golden-globes-with-wins-for-murphy-downey-jr-nolan.html (CNBC)]
**[[Lily Gladstone]] ([[Blackfeet Nation]]) becomes the first Indigenous woman to win Best Actress for her performance in ''[[Killers of the Flower Moon (film)|Killers of the Flower Moon]]''. [https://ictnews.org/news/lily-gladstone-wins-historic-golden-globe-for-best-actress (ICT News)] [https://apnews.com/article/lily-gladstone-golden-globes-win-76ab72d61f7982594d95c67047a4e0c8 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A fire in the [[Kutupalong refugee camp]] in [[Bangladesh]] destroys hundreds of shelters and facilities and displaces nearly 7,000 [[Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh|Rohingya refugees]]. [https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/rohingya-crisis/336118/unhcr-nearly-7-000-rohingya-refugees-homeless-as (''Dhaka Tribune'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/01/07/bangladesh-rohingya-fire-refugees-myanmar/455f1794-ad35-11ee-bc8c-7319480da4f9_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Bangladeshi general election]]
**Citizens of [[Bangladesh]] vote in a [[general election]] with opposition parties [[Election boycott|boycotting]] the election. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/1/7/bangladesh-election-live-country-votes-in-polls-boycotted-by-opposition (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Philippine President]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] signs a law that permits [[electronic tax filing]] in the [[Taxation in the Philippines|country]]. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/asia/philippines-enacts-new-law-that-makes-paying-taxes-easier-2024-01-07/ (Reuters)]
